messages:
rachel: Heads up — planning to enable two runtime toggles in prod canary: `flash-v2` (kernel opt) and `kv-prefetch-tweak`.
I want guardrails + audience signoff. Proposed canary: 3% prod traffic split across us-central & eu-west1, plus 100% dev/stg for smoke testing.

chen: Which flags exactly and how do we flip them? Are we using ffctl or LaunchDarkly?

rachel: Flag names:
- `runtime.flash_attn.v2`
- `runtime.kv_prefetch.tweak`

Using our in-house `ffctl`. Example payload:
```
ffctl set --flag runtime.flash_attn.v2 --on --audience "prod:3%,stg:100,dev:100" --meta "owner=rachel;ticket=ENG-4211"
ffctl set --flag runtime.kv_prefetch.tweak --on --audience "prod:3%,stg:100,dev:100"
```

anya: What are the rollback/guardrail thresholds?

rachel: Guardrails (hard):
- p95 latency must stay < 140ms absolute OR delta vs baseline < +25ms
- error rate increase <= +0.3 percentage points (5xx/total)
- OOMs or GPU mem pressure: any OOM => immediate rollback
- token cost increase <= +2%
- monitor queue depth and tail latency (p99)

We will evaluate at 15m and 1h windows. If any hard guardrail crosses, we rollback immediately.

tim: Need tracing + perf sampling. Can we add header `x-ff-variant` so infra dashboards split traces by variant?

rachel: Yes — add header and sampling rule. Also add a lightweight eval set (smoke prompts) to catch quality regressions.

ops-bot: Scheduled canary slot: 2026-03-18 23:00 UTC — No conflicting deploys in that window. :white_check_mark:

dalia: I can own the rollout. Please add me to the FF change and give me the quick runbook.

rachel: Runbook (short):
1) Announce on #eng-runtime 15m before.
2) Apply ffctl commands (see snippet).
3) Verify 100% dev/stg traffic toggles succeed.
4) Flip prod to 3% using `ffctl`.
5) Watch dashboards (latency, errors, cost, mem) and traces for 15m.
6) If stable, bump to 10% after 1h, then 25% after 3h.
7) If guardrail breaches at any step -> `ffctl set --flag <flag> --off --meta "rollback=true"` and page on-call.

chen: Also add an auto-fallback in runtime: if mem delta > +200MB per worker for 5m, runtime should auto-fallback to `flash_attn.v1`. Can we gate that?

rachel: Good call. Ops/infra — please add the mem fallback hook. I'll add a PR to runtime with that small guard.

deploy-bot: Canary started at 1778901234. Monitoring hooks: perf-suite, error-rate, cost-estimator. Alerts set for p95 delta +20ms, error-rate +0.25%. Will post updates here.

tim: LGTM — I'll watch the infra dashboards and traces. Ping me if we need manual rollback.

anya: I'll push the evals bench set `evals/runtime/flash-v2-smoke` now.

rachel: Perfect. Tag me on the PRs and I'll cut the 2-hour hold for final decision. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
